links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses to TMD patient questions across six readability indices
links.effect: ChatGPT-3.5 had the highest readability scores, meaning its responses were more complex than those of Google Gemini and ChatGPT-4o; specific grade levels not given in the abstract.
links.quote: Readability scores were highest for ChatGPT-3.5, suggesting its responses were more complex than those of Google Gemini and ChatGPT-4o.

links.outcome: Inclusion of references or citations in chatbot responses
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o and Google Gemini included references in 22.2% and 13.3% of responses; ChatGPT-3.5 included none.
links.quote: Both ChatGPT-4o and Google Gemini included references in responses, 22.2% and 13.3%, respectively, while ChatGPT-3.5 included none.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance (accuracy, completeness, reliability, readability) of three off-the-shelf LLMs answering temporomandibular joint disorder queries without testing a deployment practice or intervention.
